run.title: Run
run.pausedTitle: Paused: the lab's LLM balance is used up
run.pausedDescription: Admins have been alerted. The run resumes when the balance is topped up.

events.title: Live events
events.replayed: reused a response already paid for

approval.title: Review the {stage} output
approval.description: Approve to continue, request changes to get a new attempt, or reject to stop the run.
approval.readOnly: The run owner or a project owner decides on this output.
approval.degradedDescription: The stage could not produce a full result, so this is a fallback or partial placeholder. Check it carefully before approving.
approval.commentPlaceholder: What should change, or what the next stage should know
approval.commentHint: Optional when approving or rejecting; required when requesting changes.
approval.commentRequired: Say what should change before requesting changes.

sent.approve: Approved. The next stage will start.
sent.request_changes: Changes requested. A new attempt will start.

approval.conflictToast: This output changed while you were reviewing it.
approval.conflictDescription: Your decision was not recorded: a newer output replaced the one you reviewed, or someone already decided. Review what is shown now.
approval.updatedDescription: Version {version} replaced the output you were reading. Read it before deciding.
approval.rejectConfirmDescription: Rejecting stops the whole run. This cannot be undone.

cancel.confirmDescription: Work in progress stops and the run cannot be resumed. Money already spent stays charged.
